recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-13272 unless the project adopts a broader spelling-style policy for the RDF page.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction requesting multiple typo fixes on the RDF page: punctuation near the W3C Interest Group name, double spacing before "serialised", duplicate "the", "measn", and the spelling of "labeled".
initial_application: Jira records the issue as applied on 2017-09-06. Commit eb9c6139a0171d520d6bb76bb93be1f7c935908d explicitly included "GF #13272 - typos on rdf.html" and patched source/rdf.html for the duplicate "the", "measn", and then-used "labelled" spelling.
additional_context: Current source/rdf.html is the live RDF page source for rdf.html and has since been substantially revised. The current page has the corrected W3C punctuation, "RDF graph" spacing with "serialized", single "the" before "identity", and "means that" wording. The only close surviving issue phrase is "node labeled as a fhir:treeRoot"; commit 72143f2fd3d86e1d1de43b7aab6821463d9611ab explicitly changed "labelled" back to "labeled" as a spelling fix, making the current US spelling intentional later editorial state.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current source already contains the substantive typo corrections, and changing "labeled" to "labelled" would reverse a later explicit editorial normalization without improving the specification.
